title: FYC civic contact record
description: One published contact for one office in the canonical directory. Every record must name the page it came from: this file decides where complaints about real people's streets are sent, and a contact nobody can trace is one nobody can check when it stops working.

office_id.description: Stable id of an office already in the directory. Generated by scripts/civic_contacts_worksheet.py; an id not in the canonical list is rejected rather than created.

office_name.description: The office as the source names it, e.g. 'Zone III Office, Nagercoil Corporation'.

designation_en.description: The desk, never a person: 'Commissioner', not a name.

officer_name.description: Only if the source publishes it. Officers transfer; routing never depends on this.

phone.description: As published. Multiple numbers: one record each, or comma-separated if the source lists them as one office line.

jurisdiction.description: The area this office covers, as the source states it. Never inferred.

source_url.description: The exact page the contact was read from. Required whenever phone or email is set.

verified_at.description: The day a human read it on that page.

confidence.description: not_found is a legitimate, expected outcome and must be recorded rather than left blank.

notes.description: Conflicts between sources, ambiguity, anything the next person should know.
